Name: Content Patcher - Bearded Elliot
Author: phvraoh
Description:
[size=3]A mod that gives Elliott a little bit of a beard. He looked kind of off without one, so I decided to take matters into my own hands. This is my first one! I hope you like it. This was inspired by [url=https://opal-owl-flight.tumblr.com/]opal-owl-flight[/url]'s art of Elliott on Tumblr. Enjoy~

[b]Required Before Install: [/b]
- SMAPI 3.2.0
- Content Patcher 1.11

[b]INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS:[/b]
1. Download the required Mods above before this one. 
2. Save the .zip file to your 'Mods' folder (File Explorer > C: > Progam Files (x86) > Steam > steamapps > common > Stardew Valley > Mods)
3. Right click on .zip file and select 'Extract Here'
4. Run SMAPI (File Explorer > C: > Progam Files (x86) > Steam > steamapps > common > Stardew Valley > StardewModdingAPI)

[b]INCOMPATIBLE WITH:[/b] [/size]
- Seasonal Villager Outfits (but i plan to change that later on!)

Let me know if you have any suggestions or comments.
